integrity: Full proof and reproducible self-contained exact-integer finite-format enumeration are supplied. Computational checks are supplementary to the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact binary floating values with gradual underflow; exact doubling and modular subtraction; signed zeros identified. Equal-state absorption law is not a projected Lebesgue law. Other beta maps, nonbinary arithmetic, flush-to-zero, and rounding-dependent arithmetic excluded. Historical priority is assessed from inspected sources only.
title: Exact two-clock collapse of the binary floating-point Bernoulli map
